newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rise in Japan's trade surplus temporary-MITI.
newsitem.headline: Rise in Japan's trade surplus temporary-MITI.

text.p: Recent rises in Japan's trade surplus are a temporary phenomenon, Japan's Trade Minister Shinji Sato told reporters on Thursday.

Sato said he did not think the trade surplus would be that big of a topic at the G7 summit in Denver at the weekend, and added that U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky was not expected to attend.
But if the topic did come up, Japan would explain that recent rises were temporary and that as reform progressed the surplus would calm down in the medium to long term.

Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus, often the source of bitter rows with the United States, jumped more than 200 percent in May from a year earlier to 738.27 billion yen, the Finance Ministry said on Wednesday.
